text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Tokai Stakes has finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The racecourse was bustling with a huge crowd.
As for Shinko Windy—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy squeezed her eyes tightly shut.
By visualizing the track in the darkness, she brings her mind into a state of deep focus...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then, I've trained to flip the switch again and again.
My precision and concentration are leagues above where they started.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The desire to win
propels everything forward...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about the other girls, or the stands.
Just keep your eyes on the finish line and run. Alright...!
choice_data_list: Hang in there, you can do this!
Hang in there, you can do this!
